observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A tavern or bar interior with brick decor, tables, chairs, and a bar counter in the background, where patrons sit and watch
observation.dancers: Three dancers: one woman flanked by two men, dressed in casual 1960s style clothing
observation.formation_and_space: A line formation holding hands at shoulder height, dancing facing forward on a cleared floor space
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting actively between feet on each step
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, crossing feet behind or in front, lifting and bending knees on beats with rhythmic stamping
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms extended horizontally to the sides, hands holding the shoulders or arms of adjacent dancers in a line hold
observation.hips_and_torso: Upper body remains relatively upright and stable while legs execute steps and kicks
observation.partnering: Side-by-side line hold with dancers connected by the shoulders/arms, no independent partner coupling
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Dancers execute deep knee bends (squats) in unison, rhythmic lifting of legs, and occasional low turns or pivots
observation.costume_and_props: Woman wears a cream-colored knit dress with ruffled hem and white heeled shoes; men wear dark pants and shirts with caps
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot-to-floor weight transfer details are obscured by low video resolution and camera cuts.

signature_moments.what: The trio forms a straight line holding shoulders, stepping sideways with knee lifts in unison.
All three dancers drop simultaneously into a deep knee bend while maintaining their line hold.
The dancers descend into a synchronized low squat, then rise back up into upright stepping.
